newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Rivet buys H&L Tool for $19 mln.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Rivet buys H&L Tool for $19 mln.

text.p: Chicago Rivet & Machine Co said Tuesday it completed the previously announced purchase of most of the assets of H&L Tool Co Inc of Madison Heights, Mich. for about $19 million.

The transaction was financed by a combination of outside borrowing of $9 million, about $4.9 million of available cash, a $4.8 million credit against the purchase price in consideration of H&L Tool's retention of all cash and cash equivalents and assumption of certain liabilities of about $300,000.
Chicago Rivet manufactures rivets and other fasteners.
